entity: the 5th Circuit's cases at the Supreme Court, and the federal government's share of them
what_we_add: 16 of 38 federal-government appeals in 2021-24 vs 1 of 26 in 2015-20; other 11 regional circuits steady at about 12%; SCOTUS cases per 1,000 5th Circuit appeals 0.57 to 1.50
why: CNN says in words the 5th Circuit-to-Supreme Court trend is driven by suits against the Biden administration; Bloomberg Law says the circuit sends 'more and more cases'; SCOTUSblog shows agencies appealing its rulings again and again. No source has the counts, the other-circuit comparison or the per-1,000 rate. No contradiction: FedSoc's 0.95 per 1,000 counts reversals only, and the Bloomberg and NGA terms fall outside 2021-24.
